description: Comprehensive reference of top 10 royal and modern wedding invitation website templates for future client deployments.

templates.name: Rangmahal (The Palace)
templates.signature_animation: Carved 3D palace doors swing open on scroll into a glowing courtyard with floating marigold and rose petals
key_features: Sacred Lord Ganesha blessing with editable mantra
Four color-coded events (Mehendi, Haldi, Sangeet, Wedding)
Couple photo in carved marble jharokha frame
One-tap WhatsApp RSVP with pre-filled guest message
Good-to-know travel tiles (hashtag, weather, stay, parking)
Live dusk countdown with flickering lake diyas
Audio engine with original classical theme

templates.name: Phulkari (The Bloom)
templates.signature_animation: Intricate embroidery threads stitch themselves across the screen, unfolding bright marigold and fuchsia canopy
key_features: Boliyaan and interactive song request jukebox

templates.name: Kolam (Sacred Threshold)
templates.signature_animation: Rice-powder sacred geometric Kolam draws itself line-by-line upon page load with glowing brass kuthuvilakku lamps

templates.name: Noor (The Light)
templates.signature_animation: Fine jaali (lattice stone) screen dissolves with cinematic light rays and delicate gold arabesque flourishes

templates.name: Capela (The Coastal Chapel)
templates.signature_animation: Hand-painted blue Azulejo ceramic tiles flip and align into an arch with blooming magenta bougainvillea petals
key_features: Seaside breeze wave audio & church bell chime
Beach sundowner & church nuptial mass itinerary

templates.name: Pichola (Lake Palace Romance)
templates.signature_animation: Royal royal boat glides across rippling lake water reflecting palace lights and fireworks at dusk
key_features: Boat shuttle schedule & boarding pass card
Lakeview evening countdown with animated reflections

templates.name: Mandapam (The Sacred Canopy)
templates.signature_animation: Carved temple pillars descend into place while fresh jasmine garlands sway into a sacred mandap
key_features: Kanyadaan & Saptapadi seven vows interactive cards

templates.name: Vatika (Enchanted Botanic Garden)
templates.signature_animation: Lush watercolor peonies, eucalyptus, and wisteria vines bloom outward across a rustic linen backdrop
key_features: Sustainable wedding notes & green gift registry
Acoustic indie folk love songs player

templates.name: Rajwada (Fortress of Royals)
templates.signature_animation: Massive brass-studded fortress gates unlock with heavy iron keys and drawbridge lowering sound
key_features: Royal insignia wax seal and crest

templates.name: Aura Luxe (Minimalist Haute Couture)
templates.signature_animation: 3D metallic foil embossed wax seal breaks on scroll with fluid camera push through frosted glass layers
